name: Wordwall
description_short: A huge library of teacher-made vocabulary and grammar games (quizzes, matching, flashcards, and more) that anyone can browse and play free with no account — creating your own activities requires a free or paid account.
teacher_note: Stick to playing the community library during a lesson — it's genuinely free with no login. Making your own activities is where the account and free-tier limits kick in.
creator: Wordwall
internal_notes: Verified precisely: playing community activities (30M+) requires no login or payment at all. Creating activities requires a free account capped at 5 lifetime activities, or a paid subscription for unlimited creation and more activity types. cost recorded as freemium (not free) specifically because the catalogue entry covers the whole site and must not imply all functionality, including creation, is free. age_group/cefr_level left unknown — the community library spans a huge, teacher-contributed range with no single site-wide claim to record honestly, same treatment as Baamboozle's public library.
